name: Noel Kempff Mercado National Park
description: Tucked into Bolivia's far northeast corner along the Brazilian border, this vast park covers about 1.5 million hectares and remains one of the Amazon Basin's least disturbed. Its landscape shifts from open savannah to towering rainforest as the land climbs from 200 to nearly 1,000 metres. Visitors may spot some of the 600-plus bird species, and the park shelters threatened animals among roughly 4,000 plant species.
